label: Your Phone is RUINING Your Sleep

children.text: This video explores a study conducted to see the results of social media and phone usage before going to sleep. It focuses on a 2020 trial study published by PLOS ONE and is the only study of this kind to be conducted. It involves 38 college students with half of them having their phone usage stopped 30 minutes before they go to sleep and the other half using them as much as they like. This video outlines the results of this study but does not offer much explanation as to why the phone usage does this as it has been difficult so far to see the effects of social media and phone usage directly on sleep.
